title: ExperimentRecord
description: A company-level hypothesis: a SKU thesis the factory is (or might be) building. `experiment_id` is the unique key; `repo` must exist in repos.jsonl; `candidate_ref`, when set, must be a spec_id in recycled-candidates.jsonl (the salvage queue).

hypothesis.description: the falsifiable bet, in one line

repo.description: the SKU repo (owner/name) — must exist in repos.jsonl

metric.description: what validates or kills it (the revenue/signal bar)
